submissionNotes: Gather — open-source Sessionboard alternative. Seeded with DevFlow Conf 2027 exactly as in fixtures/sample-data.json (3 tracks, 5 session formats, 4 rooms). All four fixture personas exist with the fixture passwords; sign in at /login with password — no magic link or inbox needed, though magic links also work for real users. Organizer console at /admin, speaker portal at /portal, reviewer queue at /review. Public surfaces need no login: /e/devflow-conf-2027 (landing), /cfp (submission form), /schedule, /speakers, /sessions.
